2438-3240-6462-8347.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Sela triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

147-653-2921.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-2921.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

301-2744-4738.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6144.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6144.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Goliath Paladin from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Goliath Paladin enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Goliath Paladin.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Goliath Paladin token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Goliath Paladin that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Goliath Paladin trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6144.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

457-1329-7340-7681.description:
If Sewer-veillance Cam is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Sewer-veillance Cam.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Technodrome.
Activate Urza by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Technodrome by tapping it and sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam, causing you to draw a card and put a +1/+1 counter on Technodrome.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1496-3490-4659-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-4659-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2511-4871-6705.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Quina.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

527-647-1409.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

3967-4681-5170-5933.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2511-6761-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-6761-7084.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

1170-1329-4211-4404.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

104-1496-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1496-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

654-5720-5721-6620.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
654-5720-5721-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

677-2034-3263-5102.description:
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {5}, casting Scampering Scorcher from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Scampering Scorcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens and giving Elementals you control haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Scampering Scorcher and two Elementals, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1399-1606-1671-3457.easyPrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1606-1671-3457.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1274-1496-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1496-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1436-2752-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
Elder Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Call to Glory exiled by Isochron Scepter.
1436-2752-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Elder Druid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

549-2079-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-2079-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-2079-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2210-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrormade is a copy of Decoction Module.
{E}{E} available.
2210-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module and Mirrormade, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

3493-4289-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3493-4289-5295.description:
Activate Patrol Signaler and another creature you control by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

307-3542-5262.notablePrerequisites:
Throat Slitter and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Throat Slitter or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
307-3542-5262.description:
Declare Palinchron and Throat Slitter as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Throat Slitter from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Throat Slitter's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Throat Slitter onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1548-1953-2959.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1548-1953-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Port Razer.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Port Razer token.
Deal combat damage with any Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

859-4597-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
859-4597-4613.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Lurking Roper using Shu Farmer's ability by tapping it, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

224-433-5033.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-433-5033.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1292-2146-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2577-3263-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {R}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Repeat.

2484-2615-5016.notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
2484-2615-5016.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Blasphemous Act, dealing thirteen damage to all creatures.
Spitemare triggers, dealing thirteen damage to target opponent.

3147-3525-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Tidewater Minion.
3147-3525-4644.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
